verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas has some non-interactive automation surfaces: a REST API is listed on paid plans, and SplatTransform is a CLI/library that can convert, process and render splats. However, the Editor API and the MCP server both run against an open, browser-based Editor session, and nothing documents a headless runtime or a CI pipeline workflow. missing for 10: documented headless engine/editor execution, CI integration guidance (e.g. headless builds, tests or publishing), detail on what the REST API automates, independent hands-on corroboration.
